comments.body:
Interesting @miwi2020 

proliferating in this location (small population with young plants)

Tks
I know this cactus from the botanical garden in Funchal.
maybe that someone has taken plant material from there ?!

who knows?
Will it have invasive capacity?
I guess it is not like the Opuntias - there are very little iNat finds outside Latin America -> https://www.inaturalist.org/taxa/184567-Brasiliopuntia-brasiliensis
@vitorjcj  "Will it have invasive capacity?" Quite likely. Each cladode is capable of producing a new plant when they drop. Don't let it spread.
